gen-gf-underdog-gf-fauna-one: Wide-mouthed and bold, Underdog draws every curve with one steady pressure. Fauna One follows with a classic serif body, dignified and tall-bodied, and the heading does its best work big and brief.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-glegoo: Loud, steady and a bit playful, Underdog moves like it was drawn with a technical pen, curves wide open. Glegoo takes the quieter job, with generous counters in a tall text serif.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is a traditional serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on its s. And Underdog throws its weight around up top, horseshoe c and all, while the body keeps its refinement.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-kadwa: Underdog's c gapes open like a horseshoe, with no swell anywhere. Kadwa, a classic serif with a larger-than-usual x-height and open-ended curves, carries a long stretch of text with an editorial, unhurried ease.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-noticia-text: Underdog keeps one steady pen pressure from its first letter to its last. Its strongest quality shows against Noticia Text, a dignified serif whose lowercase fills most of the letter height, so the bold display and the literary body feel clearly distinct.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-piazzolla: Chunky, wide-grinning letters with diagonals as heavy as the verticals. Piazzolla, a serif with a lowercase nearly matching its capitals, keeps a long passage refined and authoritative, its pried-open e letting each line breathe.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-pridi: Underdog bends every curve at one pressure, its horseshoe c gaping wide, with no swelling anywhere. Pridi, a text serif with proud, almost capital-sized lowercase, reads classic and refined across a page.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-scope-one: Underdog looks bent from a single length of tubing, curves gaping wide. Scope One, a text serif with a big x-height, stubby ascenders and counters spilling into the space around them, gives that loud heading a traditional, refined partner beneath it.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px brings large open counters in a tall a, e and s, bookish and dignified. Underdog sits above it, expressive and commanding, and the classic serif's lowercase height plays against the heading's moderate one.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-suwannaphum: Underdog holds its line width uninterrupted on every letter, with a horseshoe c wide open. Suwannaphum, a serif with a squared-off, high x-height, brings a dignified editorial feel that holds up well across a longer passage.
